Thanks for trying RequirementDelta. Please describe an experience you **actually had**; the maintainer will not treat feedback as an accuracy benchmark.

## How did you try it? / 试用方式

- [ ] Python CLI only
- [ ] Codex Agent Skill
- [ ] Claude Code Agent Skill
- [ ] Installation / documentation only

## Environment / 环境

- Operating system:
- Python version:
- RequirementDelta version:
- Install method:

## First run / 首次使用

- Did installation complete? Yes / No / Not attempted
- Did you generate both `report.json` and `report.md`? Yes / No / Not attempted
- What was confusing, surprising, or time-consuming?
- Which documentation step should change?
- Which report state did you observe, if any?

## Optional public reproduction / 可公开案例

If possible, provide a **fictional or redacted** example. Do not paste actual policy documents, private eligibility facts, protected research data, usernames, identifying local paths or secrets.

## Safety confirmation / 安全确认

- [ ] I reviewed this issue to avoid exposing personal or confidential material.

For vulnerabilities, use the [private security report](https://github.com/Jozhio/RequirementDelta/security/advisories).

Maintainers should count only independently identifiable genuine first-use responses as external feedback, not empty submissions or self-tests.
